name: matraux/php-benchmark
description: Benchmarking tool for PHP 8.4+ to measure code performance with accurate time and memory profiling.

suggest.nette/utils: Required only if you use Tracy
suggest.tracy/tracy: Required only if you use Tracy

scripts-descriptions.codesniffer: Run PHP Codesniffer. Usage: "composer codesniffer {path to folder or file}"
scripts-descriptions.codefixer: Run PHP Codefixer. Usage: "composer codefixer {path to folder or file}"
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHP Stan. Usage "composer stan {path to folder or file}"
